lead_raw_text:
The structure of Hf6Si6Au4 (reduced formula Hf3Si3Au2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Hf centers in 14-neighbor environments (10 Hf, 4 Si) and 9-neighbor environments (5 Au, 4 Si), while Au centers show 10 neighbors (4 Hf, 6 Si) and Si centers have 8 neighbors (4 Au, 4 Hf). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Hf 14- and 9-vertex polyhedra and between Au 10-vertex polyhedra.
